"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Unelected bureaucrats in the executive branch now write countless rules with the force of law and arbitrarily punish individuals who disobey those rules.",

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for courts to interpret laws as written by Congress rather than allowing executive agencies to rewrite those laws to suit administration priorities.",
